subject.title: [UX] Per-agent model override not surfaced in 'openclaw models' output or settings UI

question: Should model observability gain an explicit all-agent CLI/UI comparison, or should OpenClaw rely on the existing per-agent status and Agents overview surfaces?
rationale: The missing aggregate view is real, but output placement, naming, and whether bare status should change are user-facing CLI/UI policy choices rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Add explicit aggregate view
options.body: Introduce an additive `--all-agents` or equivalent view and an Agents UI defaults-versus-override comparison while preserving existing output by default.

options.title: Change default status output
options.body: Always append per-agent overrides to bare models status, accepting additional output and possible script compatibility concerns.

options.title: Document existing surfaces
options.body: Keep current behavior and improve discoverability of `models status --agent <id>` and the Agents overview instead of adding an aggregate mode.

recommendation.title: Add explicit aggregate view
recommendation.body: Introduce an additive `--all-agents` or equivalent view and an Agents UI defaults-versus-override comparison while preserving existing output by default.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant models-status command and its established presentation contract appear to originate from this contributor's work.
